title: Investigate a performance regression in the Rust workspace at the repo root (aura-harness). User report: "Loading chat …
summary: I didn't find the cause. Nothing on the store-read path for one agent's chat got heavier since de190a1b; it still reads only that agent's latest entries, capped at 1000.
